notes: Short bill text (HD3). Both versions are near-identical in substance; X adds a recurring deadline event for the annual report. The whole operative text is one new HRS section, so under the codebook granularity rule (one row per article, role and type) the separate (a)/(b) disclosure rows and (c)(3)/(d)(1) prohibition rows are duplicates in both versions; the content of those rows is accurate. Text gives no adoption date; the 3000-07-01 effective date is a placeholder in the bill and both record it as written.
